name: stepper
description: The steps of a short multi-step flow in one row (e.g. upload a photo, check the recognized text, done), the current step marked and earlier steps checked off.

props.name: steps
props.description: Step labels, in order. Plain text.

props.name: current
props.description: 1-based index of the current step. Steps before it are done (check mark), steps after it are to do.

props.name: done_label
props.description: Accessible name of a done step's check mark.

rationale: From the application design canvas (2026-10-23), no Figma node. Orientation, not content: the data typography role in uppercase and text-subactive, like a table's header labels. The current step is told apart by color (text-active) and by shape (a solid underline of border-width-default, offset spacing-2), so it does not depend on color alone; it is not accent-1 and not dotted, so it does not read as a link (CLAUDE.md, Interaction conventions). The steps are not clickable: the flow moves by its own buttons. A done step's check mark is two borders of a rotated box in currentColor, because the icon set has no check icon (checkbox-selected is a filled box); flagged rather than adding an icon. The canvas used the base-750 primitive for the inactive steps; text-subactive is the themed semantic token for it. aria-current="step" marks the current step for assistive technology. Rendering verified in light and dark themes.
a11y_notes: An ordered list with an aria-label; the current step has aria-current="step"; the check mark is role=img with an accessible name.
